conjectures.title: Uniform reconstruction under noise
conjectures.statement: Quantify trace-distance and dimension conditions under which uniform errors in two-label marginals leave the thresholded edge set unchanged along a scaling family.

conjectures.title: Operational clock orientation
conjectures.statement: Find a physically motivated stationary constraint and resource condition that establish a robust directed internal ordering.

conjectures.title: A selected relativistic continuum
conjectures.statement: Identify independent nongeometric conditions that both eliminate the demonstrated countermodels and imply a calibrated complete Minkowski limit.
